contact_phase_definition: initialcontact is each false-to-true entry, including observed regain; sustained continues true; lostcontact is false after any prior true; precontact is false before the first true
raw_saturation_unavailable: residual_prediction returns composed actions; raw tanh/clip saturation not reconstructed from clipped commands
scope: Expert observation/past-command history; complete frozen DDIM16 plans, each native tick residual; no autonomous action-label comparison
